summary: OXO, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a 36-month Commercial Reseller Agreement with Cegeka NV. The agreement grants non-exclusive rights to market and resell subscriptions for the MMM Neural platform, with aggregate commitments of approximately $450,000. No change of control, shareholder vote, tender offer, or special-situation event is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of a commercial contract under Item 1.01. There are no deal terms or strategic event to analyze.
